per_step.command: data_dir=\"/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/\"; for file in \"\$data_dir\"patient_*.json; do /usr/local/bin/detect_ae.sh \"\$file\"; if [ \$? -eq 0 ]; then timestamp=\$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S); base=\$(basename \"\$file\" .json); report=\"/app/reports/sae_\${timestamp}_\${base}.csv\"; { echo \"patient_id,trial_id,event_id,description,severity,related_to_study_drug\"; jq -r \".patient_id + \\\",\\\" + .trial_id + \\\",\\\" + (.adverse_events[] | .event_id + \\\",\\\" + .description + \\\",\\\" + (.severity | tostring) + \\\",\\\" + (.\\\"related_to_study_drug\\\" | tostring))\" \"\$file\"; } > \"\$report\"; /usr/local/bin/notify_safety_board.sh \"\$report\"; fi; done

cat > /tmp/process.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
data_dir="/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/"
for file in "$data_dir"patient_*.json; do
  /usr/local/bin/detect_ae.sh "$file"
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)
    base=$(basename "$file" .json)
    report="/app/reports/sae_${timestamp}_${base}.csv"
    {
      echo "patient_id,trial_id,event_id,description,severity,related_to_study_drug"
      jq -r ".patient_id + "," + .trial_id + "," + (.adverse_events[] | .event_id + "," + .description + "," + (.severity | tostring) + "," + (."related_to_study_drug" | tostring))" "$file"
    } > "$report"
    /usr/local/bin/notify_safety_board.sh "$report"
  fi
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/process.sh
/tmp/process.sh
data_dir=/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/; cd $data_dir; for file in patient_*.json; do /usr/local/bin/detect_ae.sh $file; done

data_dir=\"/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/\"; reports_dir=\"/app/reports\"; for file in $data_dir/patient_*.json; do if jq -e \'.adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >=4)\' \"$file\" > /dev/null 2>&1; then timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S); base=$(basename \"$file\" .json); report=\"$reports_dir/sae_${timestamp}_${base}.csv\"; { echo \"patient_id,trial_id,event_id,description,severity,related_to_study_drug\"; jq -r \".patient_id + \\\",\\\" + .trial_id + \\\",\\\" + (.adverse_events[] | select(.severity >=4) | .event_id + \\\",\\\" + .description + \\\",\\\" + (.severity|tostring) + \\\",\\\" + (.\\\"related_to_study_drug\\\"|tostring) )\" \"$file\"; } > \"$report\"; /usr/local/bin/notify_safety_board.sh \"$report\"; echo \"Processed SAE: $report\"; fi; done

data_dir="/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/"; file="$data_dir/patient_0010.json"; patient_id=$(jq -r .patient_id "$file"); trial_id=$(jq -r .trial_id "$file"); jq -r --arg p "$patient_id" --arg t "$trial_id" \'.adverse_events[] | $p + "," + $t + "," + .event_id + "," + .description + "," + (.severity | tostring) + "," + (.related_to_study_drug | tostring)\' "$file"

data_dir="/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/"; file="$data_dir/patient_0010.json"; patient_id=$(jq -r .patient_id "$file"); trial_id=$(jq -r .trial_id "$file"); jq -r --arg p "$patient_id" --arg t "$trial_id" '.adverse_events[] | $p + "," + $t + "," + .event_id + "," + .description + "," + (.severity | tostring) + "," + (.related_to_study_drug | tostring)' "$file"

reports_dir="/app/reports"; data_dir="/app/data/cardiovive_2024/daily_entries/"; for pat in 0010 0020 0030 0040 0050 0060 0070; do file="${data_dir}/patient_${pat}.json"; timestamp=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S); report="${reports_dir}/sae_${timestamp}_patient_${pat}.csv"; { echo 'patient_id,trial_id,event_id,description,severity,related_to_study_drug'; patient_id=$(jq -r '.patient_id' "$file"); trial_id=$(jq -r '.trial_id' "$file"); jq -r --arg p "$patient_id" --arg t "$trial_id" '.adverse_events[] | $p + "," + $t + "," + .event_id + "," + .description + "," + (.severity | tostring) + "," + (.related_to_study_drug | tostring)' "$file"; } > "$report"; /usr/local/bin/notify_safety_board.sh "$report"; done
